sloka: देवतार्थे च पित्रर्थे ब्राह्मणाभ्यागतेषु च ।योधेषु मित्रवर्गेषु कच्चिद्गच्छति ते व्यय: ॥ २.१००.५६॥
transliteration: devatārthe ca pitrarthe brāhmaṇābhyāgateṣu ca ।yodheṣu mitravargeṣu kaccidgacchati te vyaya: ॥ 2.100.56॥

translations.english: I trust a man who is honest, purehearted and venerable, falsely accused of adultery is not slain out of avarice without consulting experts in scriptures.
